description: Replace the long stop-hook claude session + Task subagent workers with a deterministic TS supervisor that respawns real per-story claude sessions into one reused tmux worker slot.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed --agent/--agents/-p/--output-format json/--session-id/--permission-mode/--append-system-prompt. Workers launch via --agent <name> because the implementer/reviewer are AGENTS, not slash commands (there is no /cam-implement command; commands are issue/next/plan/prune/review/ship). Custom .claude/commands DO run under -p per docs, so that is not the reason. Use --output-format text (default) for workers so the CAM_*_STATUS sentinel stays a raw scrapeable line; json would wrap it in an envelope.

respawn-pane -k kills running cmd and reuses same pane; wait-for <chan> blocks until wait-for -S signals (signal not guaranteed buffered if sent before wait, confirm via result file); capture-pane -p dumps pane to stdout; -L socket flag is global, precedes subcommand.

Ink 7 + ink-testing-library 4 are already core deps used across src/ui/*. US-014 only extends the existing src/ui/Dashboard.tsx Stories panel and test/dashboard.test.ts; Box/Text render APIs are stable, no new Ink surface introduced.

architectureDecision: BINDING (Eduardo, 2026-06-08): each worker is a REAL separate claude session spawned via 'tmux respawn-pane -k', REUSING ONE single pane (the worker slot established at 'cam plan'). plan, US-1, US-2, ..., review all run in that SAME slot, each replacing the previous. A deterministic TS/Bun supervisor (NOT a claude, NOT Task) sequences stories. The stop-hook driver (vendor/cam-loop-stop-hook.sh + /cam-next re-inject) is RETIRED, not coexisting. Closes CAM-29. Per-story session-id markers (.claude/.cam-worker-<US>.session) enable per-story transcript token attribution, closing the CAM-21 half that depends on per-story transcripts. NON-GOALS: no new panes/windows per worker; no /clear; no Task subagents.

userStories.title: Deterministic worker result reader
userStories.description: As the supervisor, I need to read the outcome of a finished worker from prd.json + handoff.json + the implementer's status sentinel, returning a typed outcome enum, never trusting process exit alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Add readWorkerOutcome({ prdPath, handoffPath, capturedPaneText }) returning { kind: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'blocked' | 'unknown', storyId, detail }, where storyId is the ACTUAL story the worker completed (the agent SELF-SELECTS, so the supervisor does NOT pass an expected id in), derived from handoff.json lastCompletedStory.id and the CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS=DONE story=US-XXX sentinel.
'pass' requires the completed story's passes flipped to true AND handoff.json lastCompletedStory.id matching the sentinel's story=US-XXX (cross-checked, never a pre-supplied id).
'blocked' detected by BLOCKED_OPERATOR_REQUIRED or BLOCKED_* tokens in the captured pane text OR an explicit sentinel from the implementer.
Extracts the CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS=DONE story=US-XXX sentinel via simple regex over captured pane text (do not depend on jq, runtime is Bun).
Unknown only when no signals at all (used to trigger a fallback timeout/crash path in US-011).
Pure function; injected file readers.
Tests cover all four outcomes with fake prd/handoff fixtures.
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)

userStories.title: runSupervisor() loop tying primitives together
userStories.description: As the supervisor, I need a single runSupervisor() function that picks the next story, generates a uuid + session marker, respawns the worker in the slot, waits, confirms via result reader, and repeats until decideNextAction returns complete or blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: Add runSupervisor({ spawn, waitFor, capturePane, readPrd, writePrd, readHandoff, clock, maxIterations }) in src/supervisor/loop.ts.

Per iteration: call decideNextAction -> if implement, mint uuid, build implementer argv (US-003), respawn into the worker slot pane (US-001), wait on the channel, call readWorkerOutcome (US-004) which returns the ACTUAL completed story, THEN writeWorkerSessionMarker(actualStoryId, uuid) so the per-story marker is keyed to what the worker really did (never a pre-guessed id); if review, mint uuid + dispatch review worker (deferred to US-008 wiring but the loop branch exists).
Hard max-iterations cap (default 50) prevents runaway loops; cap is configurable.
All side effects (spawn / wait / capture / read / write / clock) injected so the loop is fully unit-testable with fakes.
Returns { status: 'complete' | 'blocked' | 'max-iterations', iterations, lastOutcome }.
Tests use fakes to cover: happy path 2 stories pass + review CLEAN, one story blocked then loop falls through, max-iterations cap.
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
userStories.notes: Files: new src/supervisor/loop.ts, test/supervisor/loop.test.ts. Do NOT call Bun.spawn directly here, accept an injected spawner so unit tests do not shell out. The worker slot pane id comes from readWorkerPaneMarker (US-001). Review dispatch is a placeholder calling an injected reviewDispatch fn, fleshed out in US-008. ANTI-COUPLING (review fix 2026-06-08): the subagent-implementer agent SELF-SELECTS its story, so the supervisor must NOT bind a story up front. decideNextAction's storyId is advisory (decides implement-vs-review-vs-complete and logging only); the worker is the source of truth for WHICH story, and the supervisor attributes uuid/marker/tokens to the actual completed story from handoff.json/sentinel. Removes the two-independent-selectors mismatch WITHOUT modifying the proven agent.

userStories.title: Worker timeout + crash detection
userStories.description: As the supervisor, I need a per-worker deadline and pane-death detection so a stuck or crashed worker degrades to a BLOCKED outcome instead of hanging the loop forever.
acceptanceCriteria: runSupervisor accepts perWorkerTimeoutMs (default e.g. 30 minutes, configurable via project.toml or env).

Wait path is bounded: if tmux wait-for has not returned by the deadline, check pane existence via list-panes; if pane is dead, mark outcome 'blocked' with detail='pane-died-pre-result'; if pane is alive but stuck, send respawn-pane -k 'echo timeout' and mark outcome 'blocked' with detail='timeout'.
Outcome 'unknown' from readWorkerOutcome (US-004) plus a timeout becomes 'blocked', never silently 'pass'.
On 'blocked', the supervisor logs structured event (US-013) and proceeds to decideNextAction (which may pick another story or complete).
Tests with fake clock + fake tmux: timeout path, pane-died path, recovery to next story.
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/loop.ts (extend), test/supervisor/loop.test.ts. The 'wait-for signal not guaranteed buffered' tmux finding from Step-5 is precisely why we need a deadline + pane-existence cross-check, do not rely on the channel alone. Use injected clock, never Date.now() directly in the loop.

Cross-references the canonical files: .claude/cam-loop.local.md, .claude/.cam-worker-pane, .claude/.cam-worker-<US>.session, .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl, .claude/.cam-supervisor.lock.
No em-dash characters in the persisted file (project convention).
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)

userStories.title: Real E2E: real claude sessions in the single reused worker slot
userStories.description: As the operator, I need to run cam plan + cam next against the installed claude binary and visually confirm that plan, each US-N, and review all run as separate real sessions in the SAME reused tmux pane, per-story transcripts exist, tokens are attributable per story, and --agent headless works.
acceptanceCriteria: From a clean project: cam plan establishes a worker slot pane (verify .claude/.cam-worker-pane written, pane id matches a live tmux -L cam pane).
cam next drives US-1..N as real claude sessions; visually confirm the SAME pane id is reused for each story (no new panes/windows opened).
After completion, verify per-story session markers .claude/.cam-worker-<US>.session exist for every implemented story, and each resolves to a non-empty transcript JSONL.
cam dashboard Stories panel shows non-zero token counts per story (US-014 wired correctly).
Confirm the review worker runs in the SAME slot and updates prd.review.lastVerdict.
Confirm the stop-hook driver is NOT active: settings.local.json contains no Stop hook re-injecting /cam-next; vendor/cam-loop-stop-hook.sh is not invoked.
Operator screencap of (a) single reused pane across stories, (b) dashboard per-story tokens, attached to the issue / PR.
Confirm --agent subagent-implementer headless invocation works against the locally installed claude (version recorded in the screencap).
Verify the screen renders correctly (dashboard Ink screen).
userStories.notes: Files: none (operator ceremony). Pre-reqs: US-001 through US-017 merged. Verification surfaces: tmux -L cam list-panes, .claude/.cam-worker-pane, .claude/.cam-worker-<US>.session, .claude/cam-loop.local.md, .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl, .claude/settings.local.json (must NOT contain a Stop hook for /cam-next). This story exists to catch the lessons.md 2026-06-05 class of bug: do not trust comments, render and observe. Per subagent-implementer.md selection logic the implementer SKIPS requires:'operator' stories at selection time, so the supervisor sees no implementable stories remaining and dispatches review or completes; the operator flips this story to passes:true by hand after the manual ceremony.
